title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway with AWS Step Functions connector target
description: Expose an AWS Step Functions Standard workflow as MCP tools through an Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway connector target, with a task token callback through Amazon SQS.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: An Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway with the AWS_IAM authorizer has two targets that use the built-in AWS Step Functions connector. There is no AWS Lambda function or MCP server in the tool path.
An MCP client calls StartExecution, which is pinned to a Standard workflow, and DescribeExecution through the Gateway.
The workflow pauses on a waitForTaskToken task that sends the task token and the request to an Amazon SQS queue.
The client reads the message and completes the task by calling SendTaskSuccess or SendTaskFailure through the same Gateway.
